subject: Ramp slate negotiation + checkpoint sign-off
messages:
From: Ella Morgan <ella.morgan@horizonhealth.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP + proposed ramp slate

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the product demo last week. Per our internal discussion, I've attached Horizon's draft MAP and a suggested ramp slate we would need to sign off to proceed to a pilot. Key asks:
- 3-month evaluation (pilot) with a 50k token/week baseline; cadence and checkpoint dates included in the MAP.
- Pricing cap for the pilot phase and a committed ramp to 250k tokens/week within Q3.
- Two technical acceptance checkpoints: functional (week 4) and perf (week 8).

Can Redwood confirm whether the proposed checkpoints align with the commercial terms you presented and share an updated pricing sheet that reflects a staged discount schedule tied to our checkpoints? If we can get an updated quote this week we can present to procurement next Tuesday.

Attachments: Horizon_MAP_v2.pdf (MAP with dates)

Best,
Ella Morgan
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Horizon Health
ella.morgan@horizonhealth.io
procurement@horizonhealth.io

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Morgan <ella.morgan@horizonhealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + proposed ramp slate

Ella — thanks for the clear summary and the MAP. I'm looping in Marissa (commercial) and Rishi (pricing lead) to align on the checkpoint-linked pricing you asked for. Quick answers up front:
- We can support the two acceptance checkpoints and the timing looks reasonable from an engineering/deployment perspective.
- We will produce a staged discount proposal that ties to the week-4 and week-8 checkpoints and the ramp to committed throughput.

Next steps: Marissa will produce a redline of the pricing sheet and Rishi will validate the unit economics for the proposed ramp. I'll follow up with an updated quote and a short mutual action plan that maps commercial milestones to delivery checkpoints. Targeting delivery by Thu 31 Mar EOD PT. If procurement needs an earlier internal placeholder, tell me the deadline.

Thanks — talk soon.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + proposed ramp slate (internal)

Team — quick internal sync notes before we lock the quote:
- Baseline pilot pricing: propose $0.012/token for the 50k tokens/week baseline during the pilot, with credits for overages at same rate until checkpoint-1.
- Checkpoint discounts: if functional acceptance (wk4) is met, apply a 10% discount to unit price for next tranche; if perf (wk8) is met, apply an additional 8% (stacking).
- Committed ramp: for a 250k tokens/week commit starting month 4, propose a committed-rate of $0.009/token after contract amendment (subject to commit term).
- Upside protection: include a capacity cushion policy for first 60 days to allow burst without penalty up to 20% of baseline.

Rishi — can you run sims on unit economics with these bands and confirm margin at target usage? Also confirm any SLA credit tweaks we need to bake into the pilot so procurement doesn't push back.

I'll prepare the attachment (Redwood_Commit_Quote_20270401.xlsx) with line items and structure the MAP to show checkpoint gating language for discounts.

-Marissa
Director, Commercials | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Morgan <ella.morgan@horizonhealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 17:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + proposed ramp slate

Ella — attaching the updated quote and a short mutual action plan that maps checkpoints to commercial milestones. Highlights:
- Pilot baseline: 50k tokens/week at $0.012/token for months 1–3 (pilot). Overages billed at same rate.
- Checkpoint gating: functional (wk4) triggers 10% unit discount for months 2–3; perf (wk8) triggers an additional 8% for months 3–4; discounts stack if both checkpoints pass.
- Ramp commit: committed 250k tokens/week beginning month 4 at $0.009/token for a 12-month commit; early-exit prorata adjustments described in sheet.
- Capacity cushion: first 60 days allow +20% burst without penalty; sustained overages revert to standard overage pricing.
- Acceptance tests: brief pass/fail criteria for functional/perf included inline in MAP.

Attachments: Redwood_Commit_Quote_20270401.xlsx (pricing workbook), Horizon_MAP_v2.pdf (annotated with checkpoint dates)

If this aligns, Ella, are you able to confirm procurement review on Tue 5 Apr? Marissa — if procurement asks for a deeper discount for a multi-year commit, flag the threshold where we escalate to leadership.

Best,
Soojin

Subject: Re: Ramp slate negotiation + checkpoint sign-off

Thanks, Soojin and team — reviewed the attachments with procurement this morning. The checkpoint-triggered discount ladder looks good; procurement asked for two small clarifications:
1) Can we move the perf checkpoint (currently week 8) to day 45 (to better align with our QA cycle)?
2) Can you add a line that the 20% capacity cushion is goodwill for the pilot and not grandfathered into committed rates unless we explicitly include it in the contract amendment?

Both are reasonable asks — if Redwood can update the MAP to reflect perf at day 45 and an explicit statement about the cushion being pilot-only, we can sign the MAP and proceed to contract redlines next week. Procurement confirmed Tue 5 Apr session for final review.

Ella Morgan
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Horizon Health
ella.morgan@horizonhealth.io
